bio: Enjoy Afternoon Tea in The Drawing Room, located within the opulent surroundings of luxury boutique hotel, Flemings Mayfair.  Escape the bustling streets of London’s most exclusive neighbourhood and step inside for a sophisticated and decadent treat.  Enjoy a selection of traditional sandwiches, freshly baked scones and an indulgent sweet treat selection, alongside fragrant tea blends from East India Tea Company.  Beautifully presented on an elegant tiered stand, delight in plain and fruit scones with thick clotted cream and homemade jams, Lemon meringue tart, Pecan pie and Macarons.  Afternoon Tea is served Tuesday to Saturday, from 2pm – 4:30pm.
